conviction_note: Q2 (Jun-Aug) looks like the deepest summer loss in the company's history (domestic all-store sales 85.4/91.5/96.1% in Jun/Jul/Aug on top of a 1Q gross margin down 1.9pt), against a stale single-source IFIS H1 bar of +400m ordinary, but the sales half is public in the 月次, the company has held an unreachable plan at H1 and cut in January for four straight years, and its prints move ~1%, so a mild negative lean (p_up 44) on a 2.0% scale; the findings sum (-0.8) is larger than the scaled number (-0.24) because the lessons pushed p_up toward 50 while each finding keeps its own size.
bar: IFIS consensus H1 (中間) cumulative ordinary profit 400m JPY, FY 1,050m (unchanged for 4 weeks, i.e. stale, and set before the 1Q miss) via https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=3548 (as of 2026-10-14); company FY plan ordinary 1,302m / OP 1,352m held at 1Q (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260713592416.pdf). Single estimate source with no H1 company guide, so the bar is treated as weak and findings are capped small. My H1 ordinary estimate is about -0.9bn (range -0.6 to -1.1bn), i.e. about -325% of the 400m bar.
positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position >=0.5% (short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0, as of 2026-10-14, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 1.48 (scraped): margin long modestly larger, not crowded. No skew exists. Run-up -3.89% over 20d, +2.72% over 5d. The persistent supply is ORIX: 10.93% -> 9.90% on 2026-10-01 per its 変更報告書 No.9, below 10% on 2026-10-06 (主要株主の異動), about 3.6m shares (~30 sessions of volume) still held. priced_lean_pct +0.11.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) should print a much deeper loss than last year's -581m OP. Domestic all-store sales were 85.4%/91.5%/96.1% YoY in Jun/Jul/Aug (H1 93.3%), and 1Q gross margin fell from 64.1% to 62.2% on SC-brand clearance and supply-chain costs. Against the FY26 Q2 base (sales 12,176, GP 6,988, SG&A 7,570), Q2 OP comes to about -0.85 to -1.2bn, so H1 ordinary is about -0.9bn against IFIS H1 +400m and last year's -15m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 1Q (2026-07-15, 15:30): ordinary -79% YoY, 72.6% below IFIS. Next-day move -0.27% (742 -> 740). The FY26 H1 loss print (2025-10-15) moved -1.32%; the FY25 H1 print (2024-10-15) -1.03%. This name sells profit misses only mildly.
findings.source_date: 2026-10 (月次売上速報 for Sep 2026, published around the 2nd business day of October)
findings.why_not_priced: The sales decline is public in the 月次 and partly priced: the stock fell from 742 after 1Q to 643. The gross-margin hit and the size of the Q2 loss are not public anywhere. IFIS still shows H1 +400m and FY 1,050m, unchanged for 4 weeks, so the one published estimate has not marked the quarter down. If the loss were priced, that consensus would have been cut and the stock would not trade at 31x the company's plan EPS.
findings.independence: 1Q margin data from a different document: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260713592420.pdf (1Q deck: GM 62.2% vs 64.1%, SG&A 98.8%). FY26 Q2 base from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251015/140120251010571659.pdf. Same company, but documents distinct from the 月次.

findings.finding: The FY plan (OP 1,352m, ordinary 1,302m) is out of reach after an H1 loss of about 1bn: H2 would need about 2.3bn OP against 398m in FY26 H2. But the company has revised at the 3Q print in January in each of the last four years (23/01/16, 24/01/15, 25/01/14, 26/01/14) and held an unreachable plan at H1 last year (H1 OP -77 against a plan it then cut 71% in January). A hold is the more likely outcome (~60%); a cut now would land against an already-sceptical price. The 363m fixed-asset gain due in December would lift any net-income line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The January 2026 cut (ordinary -71%) moved +0.64% the next session (悪材料出尽くし). Holding the plan at H1 last year (2025-10-15) moved -1.32%.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-15 (revision history table: 修 dates 23/01/16, 24/01/15, 25/01/14, 26/01/14; no H1 修 in four years)
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the plan is cut today, and by how much, is not knowable before the release. At 31x plan EPS the price does not look like a plan the market believes, so a hold changes little and a cut would partly be relief. Hence the small size.
findings.independence: Cut size from a different source: https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/3548_20260715_act_20260715_153026_2 (FY held at 1Q, 24% above IFIS); asset-sale gain from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260625/140120260624577978.pdf

findings.finding: September was the first positive month of the year: domestic SSS 102.8% and all-store 100.0%, with the large SC brands recovering. That gives management an 'H2 recovery' narrative for holding the plan in the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior: 月次 days are not separately measured. The stock went from 635 on 10/01 to 645 on 10/14 around the publication.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public, so mostly priced. What is left is how management frames it in the release and deck.
findings.independence: Shares a document with finding 1 (the same 月次 PDF), read for the opposite month. Counted once each, on different months.

findings.finding: ORIX, the number-two holder, has sold steadily through nine 変更報告書 since 2025-10 (10.93% -> 9.90% on 2026-10-01, below 10% on 2026-10-06). About 3.6m shares remain, roughly 30 sessions of turnover, so supply continues into and through the window, and a weak print gives it no reason to stop.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock drifted from about 790 (Oct 2025) to 643 while ORIX sold. No print-day isolation is possible.
findings.why_not_priced: The stake is public, but the timing of the remaining 3.6m shares is not. A continuous seller caps any relief bounce, which the margin ratio and short register do not show.
findings.independence: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3548&b=n202610070305 (ORIX 変更報告書 No.9 via EDINET, 2026-10-07): a different filer, same fact

findings.finding: The dividend is 38 yen annual, paid at year end only, against FY EPS of 20.63 (5.9% yield). It was funded from capital surplus after a capital-reserve reduction (2026-01-14). The 1Q deck commits to 'maintaining high shareholder returns, DOE 10.41%', and 38 yen was held even through the FY25 net loss of -2.6bn. A change at H1 is unlikely, and holding it is the floor under a miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dividend change in the record. 38 yen held through FY25 (EPS -71.6) and the FY26 cut (January 2026, dividend held, +0.64%).
findings.why_not_priced: Holding the dividend is the expected case and already in the 5.9% yield. The tail (a cut) is real but small at an H1 print, so the size nets to 0.

outside_window.finding: The FY plan is very likely cut at the 3Q print (January 2027), following the company's four-year habit, if not today.
Fixed-asset sale (part of the Aobadai HQ) delivers in late December 2026, a 363m extraordinary gain booked in FY27.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible, but the company has revised only at 3Q (January) for four years and held at H1 last year, so a hold is more likely (~60%). Returns: 38 yen expected unchanged; no buyback history. No new-year guide at an H1 print. Quarter: 1Q 進捗率 8.2% against a 5-year average of 72.1%; H1 will likely show a cumulative loss against a FY plan of +1.3bn, a progress rate below zero.
baseline_tension: The findings lean negative against a near-flat priced lean (+0.11) and a -3.9% 20-day run-up, so they partly agree with a price already marked down. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held plan framed by September's 102.8% SSS, the dividend restated, and 悪材料出尽くし after the worst summer quarter. I looked for buybacks and 優待 changes and found none, so the positive case rests on relief, not on an announcement.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative that rests on a series the market already has): the Q2-loss finding rests partly on 月次 sales. Cut from -0.8 to -0.5 and p_up moved from 40 to 44. Not to 50, because the gross margin and the loss size are not in any public series.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension (held plan, Sept SSS, dividend, 出尽くし) and confirmed I had searched for a buyback and 優待; no further change.
The guidance, September-SSS, ORIX and dividend findings were left unchanged.
